sources.entry: Measure Plugin - Make it a fun to create spec for developers and teammates. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/utom/sketch-measure) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A Sketch plugin that generates developer-facing specs from designs, including an HTML spec export and an option to export a layer's influence rect (including shadows and outside borders).
summary.what_it_does: The plugin adds measurement and spec tooling to Sketch, the macOS design app. Holding Option and clicking toolbar icons shows panels for making marks on the canvas. Its Spec Export feature generates an HTML page with one click that lets someone inspect design details, including CSS styles, offline. A separate export option lets a designer export a layer's influence rect, meaning the area covering shadows and outside borders, which matches the exported image size, rather than only the regular rect. The README says the HTML can be made one file per artboard by unchecking "Advanced mode". Installation is described via a downloaded ZIP, Sketch Plugin Manager, Sketchpacks, or Sketch Runner. The README states it supports Sketch 49.*.
use_cases: Generate an HTML spec page for developers from a Sketch artboard
Export a layer's shadow-inclusive bounds so engineers get the right image size
Share offline design specs with teammates
Inspect CSS styles and measurements from Sketch designs
Hand off designs to engineers without manual redlines
how_to_run: Download the ZIP file and unzip it
Or install via Sketch Plugin Manager, Sketchpacks, or Sketch Runner by searching for Sketch Measure
Hold down the Option key and click toolbar icons to show panels
Use the Export UI option to export the influence rect, or use Spec Export to generate HTML (uncheck Advanced mode for one HTML file per artboard)
stack: Sketch (macOS design app, version 49.* per README)
notable: Spec Export generates an offline HTML page with design details and CSS styles
Influence rect export includes shadows and outside borders, matching the exported image size
Option-click toolbar icons to show panels
Can create one HTML file per artboard by disabling Advanced mode
Installable through several Sketch plugin managers
caveats: README states support for Sketch 49.* only
Requires the Sketch app on macOS
Custom keyboard shortcuts require setting them up in macOS System Preferences
